prompt.description: The text prompt describing the content, style, or composition of the image to be generated.

image_url.description: A photo of the person to keep in the generated images (subject reference): a public URL or a base64 data URL, JPG or PNG under 10 MB. A single front-facing portrait works best.

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image.

num_images.description: The number of images to generate.

seed.description: The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time.

enhance_prompt.description: Optional parameter to use an LLM-based prompt rewriting feature for higher-quality images that better match the original prompt. Disabling it may affect image quality and prompt alignment.

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

b64_json.description: The base64-encoded JSON of the generated image.

credits_used.description: The number of tokens consumed during generation.

usd_spent.description: The total amount of money spent by the user in USD.

x-codeSamples.source:
curl --request POST \
  --url 'https://api.aimlapi.com/v1/images/generations' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_AIMLAPI_KEY>' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"model": "minimax/image-01", "prompt": "Describe what you want the model to generate.", "image_url": "https://example.com/input.jpg"}'
